title: ellipsis needs more input
rule: Append an ellipsis when the command needs more information or opens another window, view, or app.

citation.source: NN/g — UI Copy; Apple HIG — Buttons

pass_when: Ellipsis is present when more input is required or another window/view/app opens; absent when the action completes immediately.
fail_when: Ellipsis on an immediate-complete command, or no ellipsis when more input / another view is required.
overview: Ellipsis is present when more input is required or another window/view/app opens.
not_when: Not for delete / discard / confirm, or unsaved leave.
agent_hint: Append an ellipsis when the command needs more information or opens another window, view, or app.
description: Append an ellipsis when the command needs more information or opens another window, view, or app. Ellipsis is present when more input is required or another window/view/app opens. It fails when Ellipsis on an immediate-complete command, or no ellipsis when more input / another view is required.
